title: Nadella's hardest year
excerpt: Three years ago, Microsoft's CEO was a 'superhero.' Now his legacy is at stake.
content_html:
By Ashley Stewart

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

2026-07-26T08:07:01.230Z

Read in app

Three years ago, Satya Nadella catapulted Microsoft to the front of the AI race and became "like a superhero," one recent former Microsoft executive said.

In February 2023, after betting early on OpenAI, the CEO unveiled Microsoft's AI-powered Bing search engine before a packed audience outside Seattle, and declared a war on Google's search dominance. "A race starts today," he said. Waves of adulation followed. When Nadella helped navigate OpenAI's board crisis later that year, Bill Gurley called it an "amazing shift in corporate reputation." CNN Business chose Nadella as the CEO of the Year.

Inside Microsoft and across the tech industry, Nadella was hailed for seizing the future. Now, his legacy is at stake.

Microsoft's stock is down more than 24% from 12 months ago, significantly worse than the rest of the Magnificent 7. Investors have grown increasingly skeptical that the company's multibillion-dollar AI bet will deliver. Copilot, Microsoft's flagship AI product, lags behind other AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude. LinkedIn has drawn criticism for becoming flooded with AI-generated hustleporn. Xbox's business is "not healthy," its CEO recently said, and undergoing layoffs and restructuring as it tries to justify the company's record-breaking $69 billion Activision Blizzard acquisition.

And inside the company, employees are questioning Microsoft's plans to spend a record $190 billion this year to build AI infrastructure. As generative AI changes how people work, write software, and consume information, three of the company's core businesses hang in the balance: Microsoft 365, GitHub, and Azure. Investors will get a report card on these challenges on Wednesday, when the company releases its fourth-quarter earnings results.

As AI adoption spreads through corporate America, every software company is fighting to fend off the so-called SaaSpocalypse. But the battle is particularly fraught for Nadella's Microsoft, which made an early and loud bet on AI to propel the company's future. Now the company's north star has also become a potential noose.

For decades, Microsoft's productivity software has been the default homeroom where knowledge workers start their day. They opened Word to write, Excel to analyze data, and PowerPoint to build presentations. Now, millions of those workers are beginning to do all these things directly inside AI tools. Gartner analysts earlier this year predicted AI would threaten to dethrone traditional productivity suites like Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace in a $58 billion market shakeup.

Microsoft executives point to continued growth in Microsoft 365 and increasing Copilot adoption as evidence customers still want Microsoft's products at the center of their workdays. "The M365 business is seeing tons of new adoption and M365 Copilot usage," one executive said, who said the company is specifically chasing computing capacity to meet the demand.

GitHub faces a similar challenge. Since acquiring the software development platform in 2018, the company has held a dominant position with developers and had an early advantage in AI coding through GitHub Copilot. And it continues to grow: The platform recently had its "best month ever," an executive told employees in internal meeting comments viewed by Business Insider, though he didn't say by what measure.

But upstarts have swarmed in, as millions of engineers have adopted Cursor — which SpaceX recently announced plans to acquire for $60 billion — and Anthropic's Claude Code. As Business Insider previously reported, executives have discussed internally the need to overhaul GitHub to better compete with those AI-native coding tools. AI demand has also strained Github. As AI usage surged GitHub has experienced dozens of major outages this year.

The company is also struggling broadly to keep up with the demand for compute capacity. Despite this crunch, Microsoft is raising salespeople quotas for selling its cloud computing platform, Azure, some by 30% this year, according to people familiar with the change.

Azure remains Microsoft's fastest-growing strategic business, but internally executives say it has become a constant balancing act. Demand for computing infrastructure has outpaced the company's ability to build new capacity, forcing Microsoft to make difficult decisions about where its resources go. Even with this year's $190 billion capital expenditures — largely to expand data-center capacity for AI workloads — executives say the company is still constrained.

Earlier this year, Chief Financial Officer Amy Hood suggested Microsoft was prioritizing scarce computing resources for its own AI products before allocating the remaining capacity to Azure customers.

"The first thing we're doing is solving for the increased usage in sales and the accelerating pace of M365 Copilot, as well as GitHub Copilot, our first-party apps," Hood said during Microsoft's January earnings call. "Then we make sure we're investing in the long-term nature of R&D and product innovation... Then what you end up with is the remainder going towards serving the Azure capacity that continues to grow in terms of demand."

Why would Satya prioritize growing Adobe over growing M365?Microsoft executive

If Microsoft had allocated the GPUs that came online during the first half of its fiscal year to Azure instead of its own AI products, Azure growth would have exceeded 40% instead of 39%, Hood said. Microsoft previously reported $75 billion in Azure revenue for its 2025 fiscal year.

That earnings report triggered one of Microsoft's biggest post-earnings stock declined by more than 10% as investors questioned the company's slower Azure outlook despite record AI spending and growing concerns that Microsoft was diverting capacity away from cloud customers.

Executives who spoke to Business Insider say those tradeoffs have intensified.

Microsoft is so desperate for capacity that it's turning to competitors to help relieve some of those constraints. Following a series of GitHub outages, Amazon bailed Microsoft out. The company also explored leasing Oracle cloud infrastructure but Microsoft walked away due to security and compliance concerns.

Microsoft is now seeking additional cloud capacity from other providers, including evaluating Amazon and Google, according to people familiar with the discussions. "We are shopping for capacity everywhere," one of those people said.

While prioritizing internal services has a mixed reception on Wall Street, the strategy is clear within Microsoft.

"All of the supply is gone once you solve for frontier labs and our internal businesses like M365 and Microsoft AI," one executive said.

Those decisions have created difficult conversations internally.

"Why would Satya prioritize growing Adobe over growing M365?" the person said. "I have no idea how we're going to land that message with customers."

As the pressure on Microsoft's core businesses mounts, Nadella has been bearing that pressure down on his workforce, and reshaping the structure of the company and its leaders.

As Business Insider previously reported, Nadella promoted Judson Althoff to CEO of Microsoft's commercial business to free himself and the company's engineering leaders to focus more directly on AI. Althoff was previously Microsoft's longtime sales boss but the role gave him a bigger profile. In an internal memo viewed by Business Insider at the time, Nadella described the moment as "a tectonic AI platform shift."

The mounting pressure on Nadella has trickled down through Microsoft's ranks from the executive suite to the rank-and-file employee.

At the same time, Nadella has remade his inner circle. Business Insider previously reported that Microsoft effectively retired its traditional senior leadership team structure in favor of smaller, flatter leadership groups. AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman has narrowed his focus to Microsoft's superintelligence efforts, top Nadella lieutenant Rajesh Jha retired, longtime product and marketing leader Yusuf Mehdi is preparing to leave the company, and more executive changes are expected.

According to people familiar with the succession planning, Hayete Gallot, who recently returned to Microsoft from Google to lead the company's security business, is viewed internally as the long-term successor to Althoff as sales chief. Gallot previously worked for Althoff and left in what one executive told Business Insider was "not an amicable departure." Nadella recruited Gallot back to replace Charlie Bell, who moved into an individual contributor role focused on engineering quality. Rodrigo Kede Lima, who Microsoft just put in charge of a $2.5 billion AI sales unit, is also a rising star, one of the people said.

The changes extend beyond the executive suite. Business Insider has learned that Microsoft overhauled its performance review system this year, simplifying ratings into five categories while making performance distinctions significantly sharper.

Executives say the new process feels like a return to "stack ranking," the controversial system that evaluated employees relative to one another during the Steve Ballmer era. At the same time, managers have been instructed to reduce the number of employees in higher-level engineering roles as Microsoft continues flattening parts of the organization, emblematic of a broader hardcore work culture that's spread across Big Tech in the last few years.

"It's almost like the old era of Microsoft is back," one former executive said. "The old Windows era where you lead with a lot of fear and a billy club in your hand."

For years, Microsoft's greatest strength was that it owned where people worked and where developers built software. AI is beginning to challenge both assumptions at once. Now Nadella's legacy won't be defined by whether Microsoft can build the best AI, but by whether it can keep AI from eroding the businesses that made it one of the world's most valuable companies.

Ashley Stewart is a chief technology correspondent at Business Insider.

sentences.zh: 而且还在继续增长：一位高管在《商业内幕》看到的内部会议评论中告诉员工，该平台最近经历了“有史以来最好的一个月”，但他没有透露具体衡量标准。

blocks.html_en: But upstarts have swarmed in, as millions of engineers have adopted Cursor — which SpaceX recently announced plans to acquire for $60 billion — and Anthropic's Claude Code. As Business Insider previously reported, executives have discussed internally the need to overhaul GitHub to better compete with those AI-native coding tools. AI demand has also strained Github. As AI usage surged GitHub has experienced dozens of major outages this year.

sentences.en: But upstarts have swarmed in, as millions of engineers have adopted Cursor — which SpaceX recently announced plans to acquire for $60 billion — and Anthropic's Claude Code.
sentences.zh: 但随着数百万工程师采用 Cursor（SpaceX 最近宣布计划以 600 亿美元收购）和 Anthropic 的 Claude Code，新贵们纷纷涌入。

sentences.en: As Business Insider previously reported, executives have discussed internally the need to overhaul GitHub to better compete with those AI-native coding tools.
sentences.zh: 正如 Business Insider 之前报道的那样，高管们在内部讨论了彻底改革 GitHub 的必要性，以便更好地与那些人工智能原生编码工具竞争。

sentences.en: AI demand has also strained Github.
sentences.zh: 人工智能需求也给 Github 造成了压力。

sentences.en: As AI usage surged GitHub has experienced dozens of major outages this year.
sentences.zh: 随着人工智能使用量的激增，GitHub 今年经历了数十次重大停机。

blocks.html_en: The company is also struggling broadly to keep up with the demand for compute capacity. Despite this crunch, Microsoft is raising salespeople quotas for selling its cloud computing platform, Azure, some by 30% this year, according to people familiar with the change.

sentences.en: The company is also struggling broadly to keep up with the demand for compute capacity.
sentences.zh: 该公司还在努力满足计算能力的需求。

sentences.en: Despite this crunch, Microsoft is raising salespeople quotas for selling its cloud computing platform, Azure, some by 30% this year, according to people familiar with the change.
sentences.zh: 据知情人士透露，尽管面临这种困境，微软仍将销售其云计算平台 Azure 的销售人员配额提高了 30%。

blocks.html_en: Azure remains Microsoft's fastest-growing strategic business, but internally executives say it has become a constant balancing act. Demand for computing infrastructure has outpaced the company's ability to build new capacity, forcing Microsoft to make difficult decisions about where its resources go. Even with this year's $190 billion capital expenditures — largely to expand data-center capacity for AI workloads — executives say the company is still constrained.

sentences.en: Azure remains Microsoft's fastest-growing strategic business, but internally executives say it has become a constant balancing act.
sentences.zh: Azure 仍然是微软增长最快的战略业务，但内部高管表示，它已经成为一种持续的平衡行为。

sentences.en: Demand for computing infrastructure has outpaced the company's ability to build new capacity, forcing Microsoft to make difficult decisions about where its resources go.
sentences.zh: 对计算基础设施的需求已经超过了公司建设新产能的能力，迫使微软就其资源的去向做出艰难的决定。

sentences.en: Even with this year's $190 billion capital expenditures — largely to expand data-center capacity for AI workloads — executives say the company is still constrained.
sentences.zh: 尽管今年的资本支出为 1900 亿美元（主要是为了扩大人工智能工作负载的数据中心容量），但高管们表示，该公司仍然受到限制。

blocks.html_en: Earlier this year, Chief Financial Officer Amy Hood suggested Microsoft was prioritizing scarce computing resources for its own AI products before allocating the remaining capacity to Azure customers.

sentences.en: Earlier this year, Chief Financial Officer Amy Hood suggested Microsoft was prioritizing scarce computing resources for its own AI products before allocating the remaining capacity to Azure customers.
sentences.zh: 今年早些时候，首席财务官 Amy Hood 表示，微软正在优先将稀缺的计算资源用于自己的人工智能产品，然后再将剩余容量分配给 Azure 客户。

blocks.html_en: "The first thing we're doing is solving for the increased usage in sales and the accelerating pace of M365 Copilot, as well as GitHub Copilot, our first-party apps," Hood said during Microsoft's January earnings call. "Then we make sure we're investing in the long-term nature of R&D and product innovation... Then what you end up with is the remainder going towards serving the Azure capacity that continues to grow in terms of demand."

sentences.en: "The first thing we're doing is solving for the increased usage in sales and the accelerating pace of M365 Copilot, as well as GitHub Copilot, our first-party apps," Hood said during Microsoft's January earnings call.
sentences.zh: Hood 在微软 1 月份的财报电话会议上表示：“我们要做的第一件事是解决 M365 Copilot 以及我们的第一方应用程序 GitHub Copilot 的销售使用量增加和步伐加快的问题。”

sentences.en: "Then we make sure we're investing in the long-term nature of R&D and product innovation...
sentences.zh: “然后我们确保我们投资于研发和产品创新的长期性质......

sentences.en: Then what you end up with is the remainder going towards serving the Azure capacity that continues to grow in terms of demand."
sentences.zh: 然后你最终得到的就是剩下的部分将用于服务于需求持续增长的 Azure 容量。”

blocks.html_en: Why would Satya prioritize growing Adobe over growing M365?Microsoft executive

sentences.en: Why would Satya prioritize growing Adobe over growing M365?Microsoft executive
sentences.zh: 为什么 Satya 会优先考虑 Adob​​e 的发展而不是 M365 的发展？微软高管

blocks.html_en: If Microsoft had allocated the GPUs that came online during the first half of its fiscal year to Azure instead of its own AI products, Azure growth would have exceeded 40% instead of 39%, Hood said. Microsoft previously reported $75 billion in Azure revenue for its 2025 fiscal year.

sentences.en: If Microsoft had allocated the GPUs that came online during the first half of its fiscal year to Azure instead of its own AI products, Azure growth would have exceeded 40% instead of 39%, Hood said.
sentences.zh: Hood 表示，如果微软将上半年上线的 GPU 分配给 Azure，而不是自己的 AI 产品，Azure 的增长将超过 40%，而不是 39%。

sentences.en: Microsoft previously reported $75 billion in Azure revenue for its 2025 fiscal year.
sentences.zh: 微软此前公布的 2025 财年 Azure 收入为 750 亿美元。

blocks.html_en: That earnings report triggered one of Microsoft's biggest post-earnings stock declined by more than 10% as investors questioned the company's slower Azure outlook despite record AI spending and growing concerns that Microsoft was diverting capacity away from cloud customers.

sentences.en: That earnings report triggered one of Microsoft's biggest post-earnings stock declined by more than 10% as investors questioned the company's slower Azure outlook despite record AI spending and growing concerns that Microsoft was diverting capacity away from cloud customers.
sentences.zh: 该财报导致微软最大的财报发布后股票下跌超过 10%，原因是投资者质疑该公司 Azure 前景放缓，尽管人工智能支出创纪录，并且人们越来越担心微软正在将产能从云客户手中转移。

blocks.html_en: Executives who spoke to Business Insider say those tradeoffs have intensified.

sentences.en: Executives who spoke to Business Insider say those tradeoffs have intensified.
sentences.zh: 接受《商业内幕》采访的高管表示，这些权衡已经加剧。

blocks.html_en: Microsoft is so desperate for capacity that it's turning to competitors to help relieve some of those constraints. Following a series of GitHub outages, Amazon bailed Microsoft out. The company also explored leasing Oracle cloud infrastructure but Microsoft walked away due to security and compliance concerns.

sentences.en: Microsoft is so desperate for capacity that it's turning to competitors to help relieve some of those constraints.
sentences.zh: 微软非常渴望产能，因此它开始向竞争对手寻求帮助，以缓解其中的一些限制。

sentences.en: Following a series of GitHub outages, Amazon bailed Microsoft out.
sentences.zh: 在 GitHub 发生一系列故障后，亚马逊救助了微软。

sentences.en: The company also explored leasing Oracle cloud infrastructure but Microsoft walked away due to security and compliance concerns.
sentences.zh: 该公司还探索租赁甲骨文云基础设施，但微软出于安全和合规性考虑而放弃了。

blocks.html_en: Microsoft is now seeking additional cloud capacity from other providers, including evaluating Amazon and Google, according to people familiar with the discussions. "We are shopping for capacity everywhere," one of those people said.

sentences.en: Microsoft is now seeking additional cloud capacity from other providers, including evaluating Amazon and Google, according to people familiar with the discussions.
sentences.zh: 据知情人士透露，微软目前正在向其他提供商寻求额外的云容量，包括评估亚马逊和谷歌。

sentences.en: "We are shopping for capacity everywhere," one of those people said.
sentences.zh: 其中一位人士表示：“我们正在各地采购产能。”

blocks.html_en: While prioritizing internal services has a mixed reception on Wall Street, the strategy is clear within Microsoft.

sentences.en: While prioritizing internal services has a mixed reception on Wall Street, the strategy is clear within Microsoft.
sentences.zh: 虽然优先考虑内部服务在华尔街的反应不一，但微软内部的战略是明确的。

blocks.html_en: "All of the supply is gone once you solve for frontier labs and our internal businesses like M365 and Microsoft AI," one executive said.

sentences.en: "All of the supply is gone once you solve for frontier labs and our internal businesses like M365 and Microsoft AI," one executive said.
sentences.zh: 一位高管表示：“一旦解决了前沿实验室和 M365 和微软 AI 等我们内部业务的问题，所有供应就都消失了。”

blocks.html_en: Those decisions have created difficult conversations internally.

sentences.en: Those decisions have created difficult conversations internally.
sentences.zh: 这些决定在内部引发了困难的对话。

blocks.html_en: "Why would Satya prioritize growing Adobe over growing M365?" the person said. "I have no idea how we're going to land that message with customers."

sentences.en: "Why would Satya prioritize growing Adobe over growing M365?"
sentences.zh: “为什么 Satya 会优先考虑 Adob​​e 的发展而不是 M365 的发展？”

sentences.en: the person said.
sentences.zh: 那人说道。

sentences.en: "I have no idea how we're going to land that message with customers."
sentences.zh: “我不知道我们将如何向客户传达这一信息。”

blocks.html_en: As the pressure on Microsoft's core businesses mounts, Nadella has been bearing that pressure down on his workforce, and reshaping the structure of the company and its leaders.

sentences.en: As the pressure on Microsoft's core businesses mounts, Nadella has been bearing that pressure down on his workforce, and reshaping the structure of the company and its leaders.
sentences.zh: 随着微软核心业务的压力越来越大，纳德拉一直在向员工施加压力，并重塑公司及其领导层的结构。

blocks.html_en: As Business Insider previously reported, Nadella promoted Judson Althoff to CEO of Microsoft's commercial business to free himself and the company's engineering leaders to focus more directly on AI. Althoff was previously Microsoft's longtime sales boss but the role gave him a bigger profile. In an internal memo viewed by Business Insider at the time, Nadella described the moment as "a tectonic AI platform shift."

sentences.en: As Business Insider previously reported, Nadella promoted Judson Althoff to CEO of Microsoft's commercial business to free himself and the company's engineering leaders to focus more directly on AI.
sentences.zh: 正如 Business Insider 此前报道的那样，纳德拉提拔贾德森·阿尔索夫 (Judson Althoff) 担任微软商业业务首席执行官，以使自己和公司的工程领导者能够更直接地专注于人工智能。

sentences.en: Althoff was previously Microsoft's longtime sales boss but the role gave him a bigger profile.
sentences.zh: 阿尔索夫此前曾长期担任微软销售主管，但这一职位让他获得了更大的知名度。

sentences.en: In an internal memo viewed by Business Insider at the time, Nadella described the moment as "a tectonic AI platform shift."
sentences.zh: 在《商业内幕》当时看到的一份内部备忘录中，纳德拉将这一时刻描述为“人工智能平台的结构性转变”。

blocks.html_en: The mounting pressure on Nadella has trickled down through Microsoft's ranks from the executive suite to the rank-and-file employee.

sentences.en: The mounting pressure on Nadella has trickled down through Microsoft's ranks from the executive suite to the rank-and-file employee.
sentences.zh: 纳德拉面临的越来越大的压力已经渗透到微软的各个阶层，从高管层到普通员工。

blocks.html_en: At the same time, Nadella has remade his inner circle. Business Insider previously reported that Microsoft effectively retired its traditional senior leadership team structure in favor of smaller, flatter leadership groups. AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman has narrowed his focus to Microsoft's superintelligence efforts, top Nadella lieutenant Rajesh Jha retired, longtime product and marketing leader Yusuf Mehdi is preparing to leave the company, and more executive changes are expected.

sentences.en: At the same time, Nadella has remade his inner circle.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，纳德拉重塑了自己的核心圈子。

sentences.en: Business Insider previously reported that Microsoft effectively retired its traditional senior leadership team structure in favor of smaller, flatter leadership groups.
sentences.zh: 《商业内幕》此前报道称，微软实际上放弃了传统的高级领导团队结构，转而采用更小、更扁平的领导团队。

sentences.en: AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman has narrowed his focus to Microsoft's superintelligence efforts, top Nadella lieutenant Rajesh Jha retired, longtime product and marketing leader Yusuf Mehdi is preparing to leave the company, and more executive changes are expected.
sentences.zh: AI 首席执行官穆斯塔法·苏莱曼 (Mustafa Suleyman) 将注意力集中在微软的超级智能工作上，纳德拉 (Nadella) 的高级副手拉杰什·贾 (Rajesh Jha) 退休，长期的产品和营销领导者优素福·迈赫迪 (Yusuf Mehdi) 正准备离开公司，预计还会有更多的高管变动。

blocks.html_en: According to people familiar with the succession planning, Hayete Gallot, who recently returned to Microsoft from Google to lead the company's security business, is viewed internally as the long-term successor to Althoff as sales chief. Gallot previously worked for Althoff and left in what one executive told Business Insider was "not an amicable departure." Nadella recruited Gallot back to replace Charlie Bell, who moved into an individual contributor role focused on engineering quality. Rodrigo Kede Lima, who Microsoft just put in charge of a $2.5 billion AI sales unit, is also a rising star, one of the people said.

sentences.en: According to people familiar with the succession planning, Hayete Gallot, who recently returned to Microsoft from Google to lead the company's security business, is viewed internally as the long-term successor to Althoff as sales chief.
sentences.zh: 据熟悉继任计划的人士透露，最近从谷歌回到微软领导公司安全业务的海耶特·加洛特(Hayete Gallot)被内部视为阿尔特霍夫销售主管的长期继任者。

sentences.en: Gallot previously worked for Althoff and left in what one executive told Business Insider was "not an amicable departure."
sentences.zh: 加洛特此前曾在阿尔托夫工作过，一位高管告诉《商业内幕》，加洛特的离职“不是一次友好的离职”。

sentences.en: Nadella recruited Gallot back to replace Charlie Bell, who moved into an individual contributor role focused on engineering quality.
sentences.zh: 纳德拉重新招募了加洛特来接替查理·贝尔，后者担任专注于工程质量的个人贡献者角色。

sentences.en: Rodrigo Kede Lima, who Microsoft just put in charge of a $2.5 billion AI sales unit, is also a rising star, one of the people said.
sentences.zh: 其中一位知情人士表示，微软刚刚任命罗德里戈·科德·利马 (Rodrigo Kede Lima) 负责一个价值 25 亿美元的人工智能销售部门，他也是一颗冉冉升起的新星。

blocks.html_en: The changes extend beyond the executive suite. Business Insider has learned that Microsoft overhauled its performance review system this year, simplifying ratings into five categories while making performance distinctions significantly sharper.

sentences.en: The changes extend beyond the executive suite.
sentences.zh: 这些变化不仅限于高管层。

sentences.en: Business Insider has learned that Microsoft overhauled its performance review system this year, simplifying ratings into five categories while making performance distinctions significantly sharper.
sentences.zh: 《商业内幕》获悉，微软今年对其绩效评估系统进行了彻底改革，将评级简化为五个类别，同时使绩效区分更加明确。

blocks.html_en: Executives say the new process feels like a return to "stack ranking," the controversial system that evaluated employees relative to one another during the Steve Ballmer era. At the same time, managers have been instructed to reduce the number of employees in higher-level engineering roles as Microsoft continues flattening parts of the organization, emblematic of a broader hardcore work culture that's spread across Big Tech in the last few years.

sentences.en: Executives say the new process feels like a return to "stack ranking," the controversial system that evaluated employees relative to one another during the Steve Ballmer era.
sentences.zh: 高管们表示，新流程感觉像是回到了“堆栈排名”，这是一种在史蒂夫·鲍尔默时代对员工进行相对评估的颇具争议的系统。

sentences.en: At the same time, managers have been instructed to reduce the number of employees in higher-level engineering roles as Microsoft continues flattening parts of the organization, emblematic of a broader hardcore work culture that's spread across Big Tech in the last few years.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，随着微软继续扁平化组织的各个部分，管理人员被指示减少担任高级工程职位的员工数量，这象征着过去几年在大型科技公司中传播的更广泛的核心工作文化。

blocks.html_en: "It's almost like the old era of Microsoft is back," one former executive said. "The old Windows era where you lead with a lot of fear and a billy club in your hand."

sentences.en: "It's almost like the old era of Microsoft is back," one former executive said.
sentences.zh: 一位前高管表示：“这几乎就像微软的旧时代又回来了。”

sentences.en: "The old Windows era where you lead with a lot of fear and a billy club in your hand."
sentences.zh: “在旧的 Windows 时代，你手上拿着比利棍，充满恐惧地领导。”

blocks.html_en: For years, Microsoft's greatest strength was that it owned where people worked and where developers built software. AI is beginning to challenge both assumptions at once. Now Nadella's legacy won't be defined by whether Microsoft can build the best AI, but by whether it can keep AI from eroding the businesses that made it one of the world's most valuable companies.

sentences.en: For years, Microsoft's greatest strength was that it owned where people worked and where developers built software.
sentences.zh: 多年来，微软最大的优势在于它拥有人们工作的地方和开发人员构建软件的地方。

sentences.en: AI is beginning to challenge both assumptions at once.
sentences.zh: 人工智能开始同时挑战这两个假设。

sentences.en: Now Nadella's legacy won't be defined by whether Microsoft can build the best AI, but by whether it can keep AI from eroding the businesses that made it one of the world's most valuable companies.
sentences.zh: 现在，纳德拉的遗产将不再取决于微软能否打造出最好的人工智能，而是取决于它能否阻止人工智能侵蚀那些使其成为全球最有价值公司之一的业务。

三年前，萨蒂亚·纳德拉 (Satya Nadella) 将微软推上了人工智能竞赛的前沿，并成为“像超级英雄一样”，一位最近的微软前高管表示。

2023 年 2 月，在早期押注 OpenAI 后，这位首席执行官在西雅图郊外的众多观众面前推出了微软人工智能驱动的 Bing 搜索引擎，并向谷歌的搜索主导地位宣战。 “比赛今天开始，”他说。 随之而来的是一波又一波的奉承之情。 那年晚些时候，当纳德拉帮助解决 OpenAI 的董事会危机时，比尔·格利称其为“企业声誉的惊人转变”。 美国有线电视新闻网商业频道选择纳德拉为年度首席执行官。

在微软内部和整个科技行业，纳德拉因抓住未来而受到赞誉。 现在，他的遗产受到威胁。

微软股价较 12 个月前下跌超过 24%，明显逊色于 Magnificent 7 的其他公司。 投资者越来越怀疑该公司数十亿美元的人工智能赌注能否兑现。 微软的旗舰人工智能产品 Copilot 落后于 ChatGPT 和 Claude 等其他人工智能工具。 LinkedIn 因充斥着人工智能生成的色情内容而受到批评。 Xbox 首席执行官最近表示，其业务“并不健康”，并正在进行裁员和重组，以证明该公司破纪录的 690 亿美元收购动视暴雪的合理性。

在公司内部，员工们对微软今年斥资创纪录的 1900 亿美元建设人工智能基础设施的计划提出质疑。 随着生成式人工智能改变人们的工作、编写软件和消费信息的方式，该公司的三个核心业务悬而未决：Microsoft 365、GitHub 和 Azure。 周三，当该公司发布第四季度盈利结果时，投资者将收到有关这些挑战的成绩单。

随着人工智能在美国企业界的普及，每家软件公司都在努力抵御所谓的 SaaS 末日。 但对于纳德拉领导的微软来说，这场战斗尤其令人担忧，该公司很早就对人工智能下了很大的赌注，以推动公司的未来。 现在，该公司的北极星也成为了一个潜在的绞索。

几十年来，微软的生产力软件一直是知识工作者开始新一天的默认教室。 他们打开 Word 进行写作，打开 Excel 来分析数据，打开 PowerPoint 来构建演示文稿。 现在，数以百万计的工人开始直接在人工智能工具中完成所有这些事情。 Gartner 分析师今年早些时候预测，人工智能将在价值 580 亿美元的市场重组中威胁取代 Microsoft 365 和 Google Workspace 等传统生产力套件。

微软高管指出，Microsoft 365 的持续增长和 Copilot 的采用率不断提高，证明客户仍然希望微软的产品成为其工作日的中心。 一位高管表示：“M365 业务正在迎来大量新的采用和 M365 Copilot 使用。”他表示，该公司正在特别追求计算能力来满足需求。

GitHub 也面临着类似的挑战。 自2018年收购软件开发平台以来，该公司在开发者中占据主导地位，并通过GitHub Copilot在AI编码方面取得了早期优势。 而且还在继续增长：一位高管在《商业内幕》看到的内部会议评论中告诉员工，该平台最近经历了“有史以来最好的一个月”，但他没有透露具体衡量标准。

但随着数百万工程师采用 Cursor（SpaceX 最近宣布计划以 600 亿美元收购）和 Anthropic 的 Claude Code，新贵们纷纷涌入。 正如 Business Insider 之前报道的那样，高管们在内部讨论了彻底改革 GitHub 的必要性，以便更好地与那些人工智能原生编码工具竞争。 人工智能需求也给 Github 造成了压力。 随着人工智能使用量的激增，GitHub 今年经历了数十次重大停机。

该公司还在努力满足计算能力的需求。 据知情人士透露，尽管面临这种困境，微软仍将销售其云计算平台 Azure 的销售人员配额提高了 30%。

Azure 仍然是微软增长最快的战略业务，但内部高管表示，它已经成为一种持续的平衡行为。 对计算基础设施的需求已经超过了公司建设新产能的能力，迫使微软就其资源的去向做出艰难的决定。 尽管今年的资本支出为 1900 亿美元（主要是为了扩大人工智能工作负载的数据中心容量），但高管们表示，该公司仍然受到限制。

今年早些时候，首席财务官 Amy Hood 表示，微软正在优先将稀缺的计算资源用于自己的人工智能产品，然后再将剩余容量分配给 Azure 客户。

Hood 在微软 1 月份的财报电话会议上表示：“我们要做的第一件事是解决 M365 Copilot 以及我们的第一方应用程序 GitHub Copilot 的销售使用量增加和步伐加快的问题。” “然后我们确保我们投资于研发和产品创新的长期性质...... 然后你最终得到的就是剩下的部分将用于服务于需求持续增长的 Azure 容量。”

为什么 Satya 会优先考虑 Adob​​e 的发展而不是 M365 的发展？微软高管

Hood 表示，如果微软将上半年上线的 GPU 分配给 Azure，而不是自己的 AI 产品，Azure 的增长将超过 40%，而不是 39%。 微软此前公布的 2025 财年 Azure 收入为 750 亿美元。

该财报导致微软最大的财报发布后股票下跌超过 10%，原因是投资者质疑该公司 Azure 前景放缓，尽管人工智能支出创纪录，并且人们越来越担心微软正在将产能从云客户手中转移。

接受《商业内幕》采访的高管表示，这些权衡已经加剧。

微软非常渴望产能，因此它开始向竞争对手寻求帮助，以缓解其中的一些限制。 在 GitHub 发生一系列故障后，亚马逊救助了微软。 该公司还探索租赁甲骨文云基础设施，但微软出于安全和合规性考虑而放弃了。

据知情人士透露，微软目前正在向其他提供商寻求额外的云容量，包括评估亚马逊和谷歌。 其中一位人士表示：“我们正在各地采购产能。”

虽然优先考虑内部服务在华尔街的反应不一，但微软内部的战略是明确的。

一位高管表示：“一旦解决了前沿实验室和 M365 和微软 AI 等我们内部业务的问题，所有供应就都消失了。”

这些决定在内部引发了困难的对话。

“为什么 Satya 会优先考虑 Adob​​e 的发展而不是 M365 的发展？” 那人说道。 “我不知道我们将如何向客户传达这一信息。”

随着微软核心业务的压力越来越大，纳德拉一直在向员工施加压力，并重塑公司及其领导层的结构。

正如 Business Insider 此前报道的那样，纳德拉提拔贾德森·阿尔索夫 (Judson Althoff) 担任微软商业业务首席执行官，以使自己和公司的工程领导者能够更直接地专注于人工智能。 阿尔索夫此前曾长期担任微软销售主管，但这一职位让他获得了更大的知名度。 在《商业内幕》当时看到的一份内部备忘录中，纳德拉将这一时刻描述为“人工智能平台的结构性转变”。

纳德拉面临的越来越大的压力已经渗透到微软的各个阶层，从高管层到普通员工。

与此同时，纳德拉重塑了自己的核心圈子。 《商业内幕》此前报道称，微软实际上放弃了传统的高级领导团队结构，转而采用更小、更扁平的领导团队。 AI 首席执行官穆斯塔法·苏莱曼 (Mustafa Suleyman) 将注意力集中在微软的超级智能工作上，纳德拉 (Nadella) 的高级副手拉杰什·贾 (Rajesh Jha) 退休，长期的产品和营销领导者优素福·迈赫迪 (Yusuf Mehdi) 正准备离开公司，预计还会有更多的高管变动。

据熟悉继任计划的人士透露，最近从谷歌回到微软领导公司安全业务的海耶特·加洛特(Hayete Gallot)被内部视为阿尔特霍夫销售主管的长期继任者。 加洛特此前曾在阿尔托夫工作过，一位高管告诉《商业内幕》，加洛特的离职“不是一次友好的离职”。 纳德拉重新招募了加洛特来接替查理·贝尔，后者担任专注于工程质量的个人贡献者角色。 其中一位知情人士表示，微软刚刚任命罗德里戈·科德·利马 (Rodrigo Kede Lima) 负责一个价值 25 亿美元的人工智能销售部门，他也是一颗冉冉升起的新星。

这些变化不仅限于高管层。 《商业内幕》获悉，微软今年对其绩效评估系统进行了彻底改革，将评级简化为五个类别，同时使绩效区分更加明确。

高管们表示，新流程感觉像是回到了“堆栈排名”，这是一种在史蒂夫·鲍尔默时代对员工进行相对评估的颇具争议的系统。 与此同时，随着微软继续扁平化组织的各个部分，管理人员被指示减少担任高级工程职位的员工数量，这象征着过去几年在大型科技公司中传播的更广泛的核心工作文化。

一位前高管表示：“这几乎就像微软的旧时代又回来了。” “在旧的 Windows 时代，你手上拿着比利棍，充满恐惧地领导。”

多年来，微软最大的优势在于它拥有人们工作的地方和开发人员构建软件的地方。 人工智能开始同时挑战这两个假设。 现在，纳德拉的遗产将不再取决于微软能否打造出最好的人工智能，而是取决于它能否阻止人工智能侵蚀那些使其成为全球最有价值公司之一的业务。
